about_the_game:
Become a "Wheelchair Sloth"!

You are a resourceful sloth who figured out that a wheelchair is the best way to get around. With short legs and long arms, rolling beats crawling every time. This hilariously challenging physics-based wheelchair simulator dares you to master the art of momentum and movement.

Solo or Co-op

Take on the challenge with a unique dual-handed control system, either play with a friend where each of you control one side of the wheel .or play solo using left-right hand coordination.

Realistic Wheelchair Mechanics

Grounded, physics-based controls capture the nuances of wheelchair movement. Even the smallest gap or bump can feel like an impossible challenge.

Competitive Obstacle Course

Navigate creatively designed levels filled with both wacky and relatable obstacles. Discover faster and more innovative ways to beat each course.

short_description: Play solo or co-op as a clever sloth. With short legs and long arms, wheelchair is the fastest way to move. Navigate diverse mini levels, master wheelchair momentum and physics, and work together to get back to your treehouse.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
